title: Breathing Exercises And A Cat
description: Relax and breathe with Breathing Exercises And A Cat – minimalist guided sessions featuring a cute cat companion for daily calm.
longDescription:
Relax and breathe with Breathing Exercises And A Cat – minimalist guided sessions featuring a cute cat companion for daily calm.

Breathing exercises reduce stress, boost focus, and improve sleep. Our black & white design with subtle cat icons makes every session fun and soothing.

**Key Features:**

- **Guided Sessions:** Wave/orb animations for box breathing (4-4-4-4), 4-7-8, and custom paced techniques. Infinite loops with haptic feedback.
- **Quick Picker:** Choose your technique and duration (1/3/5/custom minutes) – begin and follow your cat guide.
- **Gamification:** Streaks, activities/minutes tracking, favorite technique stats, and detailed analytics.
- **History & Stats:** Sessions list with cards showing total time, breaths, and best streak.
- **Reminders & Widgets:** Daily nudges plus quick home screen access.
- **HealthKit Sync:** Mindful minutes automatically logged.
- **Offline & Private:** Core experience is ad-free.

Breathe with your cat companion today!

legal.privacyPolicy:
**1. Introduction**

Welcome to Breathing Exercises And A Cat ("the App"). We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your information when you use our App.

**2. Information We Collect**

*Data You Provide:*
- Breathing session data (technique, duration, completion status)
- Custom breathing patterns you create
- Reminder preferences and settings
- Feedback and support communications

*Automatically Collected Data:*
- Device information (device type, operating system version)
- App usage analytics (features used, session duration)
- Crash reports and performance data

*HealthKit Data (Optional):*
- With your explicit permission, we write Mindful Minutes to Apple HealthKit. This data is processed locally on your device and is never sold or shared with third parties.

**3. How We Use Your Information**

We use your data to:
- Provide and improve the App's core functionality
- Track your breathing streaks and statistics
- Sync your data securely across your devices
- Send optional reminder notifications
- Respond to support requests
- Improve app performance and fix bugs

**4. Data Storage and Security**

- Your data is encrypted both in transit and at rest
- We use industry-standard security measures to protect your information
- Cloud-synced data is stored on secure servers
- You can export or delete your data at any time from within the App

**5. Data Sharing**

We do NOT sell your personal data. We may share data only:
- With service providers who help us operate the App (cloud hosting, analytics)
- If required by law or to protect our legal rights
- With your explicit consent

**6. Third-Party Services**

The App may use:
- RevenueCat for subscription management
- Analytics services for app improvement
- Cloud services for data backup

These services have their own privacy policies governing their use of data.

**7. Your Rights**

You have the right to:
- Access your personal data
- Correct inaccurate data
- Delete your data
- Export your data
- Opt out of analytics
- Withdraw consent for optional features

**8. Children's Privacy**

The App is not intended for children under 13. We do not knowingly collect data from children under 13. If you believe a child has provided us with personal data, please contact us.

**9. Changes to This Policy**

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of significant changes through the App or via email.

**10. Contact Us**

If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or your data, please contact us at the email address provided below.
